# Captured from commit 62b7c18, GNU Fortran (Ubuntu 15.2.0-16ubuntu1) 15.2.0, CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug,
# by tests/reference/kinematics/regenerate.sh (test_kin_golden --write).
# Updated (D-018.15, approved): kin_to_spatial_tangent of the updated Lagrangian (derivative of
# the Euler-Almansi strain), spatial logarithmic (derivative of ln b) and material logarithmic
# (derivative of ln C and rotation) kinematics; 104 records (to_spatial_tangent of every case but
# the identity and the pure rotations), by test_kin_golden --write on the updated code.
# Golden values (double precision), written by the test with --write.
# <key> | <n> | <IEEE-754 bits of each value, hex>
# Removed (D-018.8, D-018.18l): the 247 records of the OO-only API without a kernel equivalent: 63
# push-forward/pull-back records of the small strain kinematics (identity bindings), 167 corotational
# records without a rotation and of the polymorphic copy (the `has_rotation` flag), 16 `update_F_base`
# records and 1 of the defaults of the OO objects. The 20 corotational records `state strain, R_rot, J,
# has_rotation` are now `state strain, R_rot, J` (the same values without has_rotation). The other
# 1804 records are reproduced bit for bit by the kernel API (test_kin_golden.fypp).
# Updated (D-018.19a, approved): dp spectral decompositions of C and b by Jacobi rotations when a
# relative eigenvalue gap lies in [1e-12, 1e-2) (KIN_JACOBI_GAP_LO/HI_dp; was always the closed form with
# the Cayley-Hamilton eigenprojections, ~eps/gap^2); 82 of the 1824 records changed (the cases
# `small strain` and `incremental small rotations`, <= 2.4e-8 relative), by test_kin_golden --write.
